doc: The same Earth with a negative rotation period: spin = copysign(1, period) = -1 flips the sign of the whole profile (scale is unchanged: abs(period)). 181 float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree. Float64 closed form (gaussians, a smoothstep, a scale): rtol 1e-9. Arguments: lat (input, rad), hadley_deg and body (params). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.4e-14 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 8e3x that spread.
